title: The Last Letter Revisited
author: Bram Whitlock
blurb: Jonah Dravenmoor, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
